'''Yverdon-Sport FC''' is a Swiss [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Yverdon-les-Bains]] that competes in the [[Challenge League (Switzerland)|Challenge League]], the second tier of Swiss football. The club plays its home matches at the [[Stade Municipal (Yverdon)|Stade Municipal]]."}}
